description: Search the user's MarkIt library with a natural-language query plus optional structured filters. Returns up to 30 ranked results in a single page (no pagination in relevance mode). Example: {query: 'pasta recipes', source: 'youtube', limit: 5}. OMIT query to list the newest saves in date order (use this for "what did I save recently/last") - filters and limit still apply. If nothing relevant comes back, retry with fewer filters or different query words. English queries rank best. Scores are only comparable within one response.

category.description: Category name - see list_categories for valid names

excludeSource.description: Exclude a platform/domain (same format as source)

query.description: Natural-language topic, e.g. 'AI coding tools'. Omit for a newest-first date listing.

source.description: Platform key (instagram|tiktok|youtube|twitter|github|linkedin|facebook) or a domain substring

name: search
title: Search saved items
